note: Cue names the page may return from __load (cues[].name) = the keys of sfx. db = peak level of the sound in dBFS (default -12); dur only for uses_dur sounds. Unknown names fail the build. Regenerate: npx tsx packages/cutout/src/cli.ts sfx-table

slide.description: paper foley: paper sliding across a desk, grainy swish that slows at the end

slide-long.description: paper foley: longer paper drag with a small edge catch in the middle

rustle.description: paper foley: loose paper rustling, crackly fibres

flip.description: paper foley: a sheet turned over: air swish then a soft landing tap

fold.description: paper foley: paper crease: crackle plus pressed-paper shhk and soft body

unfold.description: paper foley: paper opening up, gentler crackle with a swell

snip.description: paper foley: scissors: two metal blade clicks with the paper tear between

thud.description: paper foley: a cut piece dropped flat on the desk, low and short

stamp.description: paper foley: heavy rubber stamp slam: low body, ink smack and a wet squish

scratch.description: paper foley: marker drawing a loop, friction rising and turning

rip.description: paper foley: tape or paper tear, ragged teeth getting faster

tap.description: paper foley: finger tap on the desk, warm and dull

tick.description: paper foley: dry pencil tap, short woody ring

whoosh.description: paper foley: paper swished through the air, soft

rewind.description: paper foley: fast tape scrub with flutter, rising

sting.description: paper foley: two upright-bass notes (G2 then D2) with a rim hit: verdict accent

tick-synth.description: procedural (packages/test3d/src/audio.ts): one tiny dry click (4 variants rotated, cues closer than 12 ms merge)

thud-synth.description: procedural (packages/test3d/src/audio.ts): heavy piece falls on stone and rolls

coin.description: procedural (packages/test3d/src/audio.ts): coin clink with a short ring (4 variants)

tap-synth.description: procedural (packages/test3d/src/audio.ts): small piece set down: dull knock

chime.description: procedural (packages/test3d/src/audio.ts): soft two-note chime, long decay (chapter mark)

swell.description: procedural (packages/test3d/src/audio.ts): airy filtered-noise swell, uses dur

tape.description: masking-tape strip pulled and pressed (same file as rip)
